decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the Location Plan and Second Floor Plan submitted 04 January 2011and the Building Control Plans submitted on Received 24 January 2011 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for an IT Training and Test Centre on the second floor of No.262 Twickenham Road shall not be carried on outside the following times: 9am - 530pm Monday to Friday and 9am - 4pm on Saturdays and none on Sundays and bank holidays.

Condition : 4 - The permission hereby granted relates solely to the use of the second floor as an IT training and test centre and no other D1 use shall be permitted without the benefit of a further planning permission.
description: Change of use of the second floor from office use to D1 (educational) use
